scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy
scripts.build:wasm: rm -f public/wasm/package.json public/wasm/flipthetable_game_bg.wasm.gz && wasm-pack build ../crates/game --target web --dev --out-dir ../../web/public/wasm --out-name flipthetable_game && gzip -1 -f public/wasm/flipthetable_game_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:release: rm -f public/wasm/package.json public/wasm/flipthetable_game_bg.wasm.gz && wasm-pack build ../crates/game --target web --release --out-dir ../../web/public/wasm --out-name flipthetable_game && gzip -9 -f public/wasm/flipthetable_game_bg.wasm
